stories.headline: Memory chips are up 10x — and holiday electronics prices are paying for it
stories.summary: AI data centers have drained the memory-chip supply; some chip prices are up tenfold in a year, SK Hynix is sold out of DRAM through 2029, and MacBook prices are up $100–500 while the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max start $100 higher.

stories.headline: The leaked GTA 6 Xbox build now boots on PC — at about 1 frame per second
stories.summary: Cyberleek released the missing executable on Nov 23; the open-source VIctory project says the game boots and reaches the prologue, menus at 30fps but ~1fps in the world — not playable.

stories.headline: Rockstar devs reveal GTA 6's cut features — tennis, crawling, cinemas
stories.summary: Tennis was cut because it wasn't good enough, cinemas weren't interactive enough, and crawling plus safehouse furnishing were also dropped. Story missions can't be replayed, unlike GTA 5.

stories.headline: GTA 6 is closing in on 40 million copies — 683 million hours in four days
stories.summary: Nearly 40M copies sold across PS5 and Xbox; PS5 players logged 683 million hours over the launch weekend, a platform record. The game also picked up eight Game Awards nominations, including Game of the Year.

stories.headline: Trump unveils new tariffs on 14 trading partners
stories.summary: Proposed tariffs target 14 major trading partners over factory overcapacity; meanwhile EU leaders meet over the bloc's long-term budget, North Korea signals further nuclear expansion, and Ukraine diplomacy faces renewed uncertainty.

stories.headline: Fuel tanker fire kills at least 31 on Cairo's ring road
stories.summary: A fuel tanker overturned on Giza's Ring Road on Wednesday and caught fire; at least 31 people died and about 21 were injured.

stories.headline: The 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade moves to Saturday
stories.summary: NYC Mayor Mamdani announced the 100th parade is rescheduled from Thursday to Saturday due to forecasts of heavy rain and strong winds.
